title: A Synchronized Multi-IMU Wearable System for Tracking of Joint-Angles in Sports Motion Analysis With Reference-Based Validation and Dynamic Task Characterization
why: Synchronized multi-IMU wearable for joint angles, validated against a YOLOv11 markerless vision reference on seated knee flexion-extension: drift 1.5e-6 deg/min over a 2h12min elbow hold, 0.6442° noise-limited resolution. Abstract read of a Jul 2026 preprint; error only "low".
notes: R-2, run 65. The four strings are transcribed from the `Exactly what is dispatched` table of the nomination commit above, which was pushed 17 seconds before the dispatch — not read back from production. This entry is therefore weaker than 242's: the JSON file itself was written after the publication, so the guarantee it carries is `the strings came from a commit that predates the dispatch`, and it rests on the transcription being faithful. `verifyWith` is how anyone checks that; scripts/validate-nominations.mjs checks the url and title verbatim against that commit whenever the commit is present in the clone.
